name: prochame
description: Prochame — open-source macOS invisible AI overlay — three separate inputs (screen, mic, system audio) into an LLM. Free, self-hosted AI copilot. Forked from cue (Blueturboguy07/cue).
author: Ganeshp000

extendInfo.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Prochame transcribes your microphone so it can help you in conversations.
extendInfo.NSCameraUsageDescription: Prochame does not use the camera.
extendInfo.NSAudioCaptureUsageDescription: Prochame captures system audio to transcribe the other participant in a call.
